newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil plans seismic on Barents Snoehvit gas fiel.
newsitem.headline: Statoil plans seismic on Barents Snoehvit gas fiel.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil) said on Thursday it planned to start in May a three-dimensional survey on the Snoehvit gas field in the Barents Sea using the Geco Beta survey vessel.
Snoehvit lies in the Tromsoe Patch off northern Norway and is the largest proven field in the area.
A core team was established late last year to study the project, which aims to come up with a development project for the field, the company's Status Weekly newsletter said.
Statoil is operator of production licences 110 and 099, while Norsk Hydro ASA operates 097. All three licences embrace Snoehvit.
Other partners are Total, Elf Petroleum, Fina Inc, Amerada Hess and Deminex.
